\caption{Robustness across four DermaMNIST partition designs, all on the Flower simulation runtime with the same ten paired seeds. The IID partition is the theoretical-null condition; the specialist row is the pre-registered specialist counterfactual described in \S\ref{sec:hyp-specialist} (same client sample counts $n_i$ as the engineered partition, every minority class assigned to exactly one client rather than two; included to probe whether the pairing structure --- not just label skew --- drives the FedProx effect); Dirichlet and balanced-paired are descriptive robustness rows. Values are mean $\pm$ SD across seeds; $\Delta$ is the within-pair FedProx $-$ FedAvg difference; $p$ is the two-sided paired Wilcoxon $p$-value. \textbf{No row is bolded} because none of the four per-partition contrasts reaches $\alpha = 0.05$ at $n = 10$ paired seeds. The IID row's slightly negative descriptive $\Delta$ matches the theoretical-null prediction; the specialist row's magnitude relative to balanced-paired is inferentially indeterminate at this sample size (\S\ref{sec:partition-robustness}).}
